note: Roz's cover-story agenda loses its parts, so nothing says which clue breaks her alibi or what each earns.

value.shows: Someone inked a 5 over last night's low tide time on Ada's schedule.
value.reaction: Gets flustered and says anyone could have changed it. She still slept all night.

value.shows: Last night's low tide was at two, so the causeway was dry from one to three.
value.reaction: Says lots of people could have crossed at two, but she was asleep.

value.shows: Roz was alone in Ada's cottage yesterday, where the schedule hangs.
value.reaction: Goes pale and says she only popped in to show Ada her beacon drawings.
